text:
Ellen Meyer: Quick help - we had a sponsor pick up the team dinner at DevSummit but the Banquet invoice lists the full charge under my name and company. Sponsor needs us to split charges for their accounting. Vendor says they can only issue one invoice. How do we record this in Concur and avoid billing the sponsor incorrectly?

Marcus Li: Were guests itemized on the bill? If they were we can ask vendor for a split invoice or a credit+separate invoice for sponsor portion.

Ellen Meyer: They provided the itemized folio with guest names, but the PDF invoice header is our company + VAT reg. Sponsor emailed they will reimburse their share directly but they need an invoice that shows the sponsor name and VAT.

ExpenseBot: Note: policy requires an invoice to match the party seeking VAT reclaim. Third-party reimbursements should include either (a) a vendor-issued split invoice/credit memo, or (b) a reimbursement agreement signed by both parties. See https://redwood.internal/expenses/third-party-payments :bookmark_tabs:

Maya Chen (Finance): We can handle this two ways: 1) Ask vendor to issue a credit for sponsor share and a separate invoice to Sponsor Co. with their VAT reg#, OR 2) If vendor cannot reissue, Sponsor can reimburse us and provide a signed reimbursement statement plus their invoice needs for their books. For Concur: record full original charge under your expense, attach vendor folio, and add a note "Sponsor reimbursement pending". Create a vendor chase ticket using AP-TICKET-2026-99.

Sophie Grant (Manager): Manager note: I approve splitting this item. Sponsor portion approved to be reimbursed separately. Ellen, please get sponsor confirmation email and vendor contact for chase.

Ellen Meyer: Sponsor confirmation attached (screenshot). Vendor contact is events@citybanquets.pt. Amounts: total €980.00, sponsor portion €350.00 (wine and private room). I put the expense in Concur and flagged as "third-party reimbursement". Link: https://concur.internal/expense/EX-2891 (attachment uploaded).

Maya Chen (Finance): Thanks. I'll open AP-TICKET-2026-99 and request credit + separate invoice to Sponsor Co. If vendor refuses, AP will ask Sponsor for a signed reimbursement letter and we will process net of sponsor amount once funds are received. Expect update in 3 business days.

Marcus Li: FYI - Sponsor also asked we send a copy of the folio with VAT line highlighted. Ellen, can you add that to the Concur upload?

Ellen Meyer: Done. Uploaded highlighted folio and sponsor email.

ExpenseBot: Actions created: AP-TICKET-2026-99, CONCUR-EXP-2891. Reminder: retain all emails for audit.

Maya Chen (Finance): Closing loop: AP will follow up and post resolution in this thread. If vendor issues credit, do not submit partial reimbursement until AP confirms. :white_check_mark:
